tools.name: create_group
tools.description: Create a Secret Santa (Wichteln) group with its participants. Returns organizer_link (give it to the organizer, it is their private admin page) and group_token for the other tools. Sends no e-mail to participants.

tools.name: get_group
tools.description: Participants, exclusions, whether the draw can work (and why not), and the status.

tools.name: add_participants
tools.description: Add people to a group that is not drawn yet.

tools.name: add_exclusion
tools.description: E.g. couples: neither draws the other. Use the exact names from get_group.

tools.name: draw
tools.description: Draw who gives a present to whom, following the exclusions. Nobody, including you, sees the result: each person sees only their own match through their private link (get_links).

tools.name: get_links
tools.description: After the draw: one private link per person to pass on. Do not open them yourself.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_group" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
